recommendations.proposal: Normalize from an explicit source schema and reject unsupported precision, temporal and complex-value cases before publishing an editable snapshot.
recommendations.rationale: JavaScript Number and current parsers can lose exact int64/decimal meaning even when transport uses strings; date parsing rounds to milliseconds.
